criteria.requirement: Implement simplejson.strict.strict_loads(document,*,use_decimal=False) using the real decoder. Reject duplicate object keys at every depth after escape decoding, NaN/Infinity and finite-text numbers that overflow binary float. use_decimal=True preserves exact finite Decimal values and integer behavior. Accept normal UTF-8 bytes and text, preserve native JSON syntax errors and do not change existing loads defaults or globally toggle decoder engines.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
